identity.title: Concerto pour saxophone alto et orchestre
identity.match: Strong attribution correction: Leduc/Hal Leonard and BnF identify René.

findings: Leduc's current Hal Leonard listing identifies René Challan, not Henri, and alto saxophone/piano reduction AL20337, HL48181147. This explains the catalog's inherited Henri attribution despite some retailers repeating it.
BnF's authority record for René explicitly cites Concerto pour saxophone alto et orchestre, copyright 1946. This is publication evidence, distinct from secondary work lists dating composition 1944.
Towson University's classical saxophone curriculum includes Challan's Concerto in advanced undergraduate repertoire. No SaxoBrain pedagogical year is assigned.
